title: Kasautii Zindagii Kay Actress Antara Banerjee Arrested for Alleged Razor Attack on RPF Official
excerpt: The 31-year-old actress was detained after allegedly attacking a Railway Protection Force officer with a razor blade during a dispute over a reserved coach seat on the Aravali Express.
body:
• Antara Banerjee, 31, a model and actress known for roles in Kasautii Zindagii Kay and Ragini MMS Returns Season 2, was arrested after allegedly attacking a Railway Protection Force official with a razor blade on the Aravali Express.
  • Police allege the confrontation began when Banerjee, travelling to Surat for a shoot, entered a reserved AC coach with a sleeper-class ticket and refused to vacate her seat.
  • Officers also allege that the actress deliberately injured herself during the altercation and stripped in front of railway personnel.
  • Banerjee has been booked under multiple sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and is currently in police custody.

Indian television actress Antara Banerjee, known for her role in the Star Plus serial Kasautii Zindagii Kay, was arrested after she allegedly attacked a Railway Protection Force official with a razor blade aboard the Aravali Express, according to police and multiple Indian media reports.

What Happened on the Train

Police allege that Banerjee, 31, boarded the Aravali Express bound for Surat, where she was reportedly headed for a shoot. She held a sleeper-class ticket but entered a reserved air-conditioned coach, according to officers.

When the ticket examiner asked her to move to her designated compartment, a verbal confrontation escalated. Railway Protection Force personnel were called in to resolve the situation. Police allege that during the altercation, Banerjee attacked an RPF official with a razor blade, injuring him. Officers also allege she deliberately injured herself and stripped in front of railway personnel during the incident, according to News18.

Banerjee was taken into custody at the next station. She has been booked under multiple sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, including assault on a public servant and voluntarily causing hurt with a dangerous weapon.

Who Is Antara Banerjee?

Antara Banerjee is a Kolkata-born actress who moved to Mumbai in 2013 to pursue a career in entertainment. She gained recognition for her role in Ekta Kapoor's Kasautii Zindagii Kay, the reboot of the iconic Star Plus serial, where she starred alongside Erica Fernandes and Parth Samthaan before exiting the show in 2019.

Her other credits include crime dramas Savdhaan India, Gumrah: End of Innocence, and Laal Ishq, as well as a cameo in the 2014 film The Shaukeens starring Akshay Kumar. She also appeared in Sunny Leone's Ragini MMS Returns Season 2 on ALTBalaji. Beyond acting, Banerjee is trained in Kathak dance, having practiced for nearly 15 years, and has performed at stage events in Kolkata.

Social Media Reaction

The arrest quickly became a trending topic on Indian social media, with the actress's name drawing over 500,000 searches on Google Trends. The incident has sparked debate about public conduct on Indian railways and the responsibilities of public figures. Some commentators have called for restraint in judgment until the full facts emerge, noting that only police accounts of the incident are publicly available.

Railway Safety and Ticketless Travel

The incident highlights a recurring problem on Indian railways: passengers boarding reserved coaches without valid tickets. Indian Railways and the RPF have intensified crackdowns on ticketless travel in recent years, with fines and penalties being imposed across the network. Confrontations between passengers and railway officials, though usually resolved without violence, have occasionally led to serious altercations.

What's Next

Banerjee remains in police custody. The investigation is ongoing, and authorities are expected to review CCTV footage from the train. No bail application has been reported so far. The RPF official who was allegedly injured is being treated for his wounds.
